entities.summary: Benjamin Booker is an American musician, singer, songwriter and guitarist. He cites the Gun Club, Blind Willie Johnson and T. Rex as influences. His music was described by the Chicago Tribune as "a raw brand of blues/boogie/soul", by The Independent as "frenzied guitar-strumming and raw, soulful vocals that are hair-raising in intensity", and by Spin as "bright, furious, explosive garage rock."
